title: Reliability Fundamentals: Availability Math & Failure Domains — D4
purpose: Shows identities, trust boundaries, policy checks, and audit evidence.
routing_rationale: Serial architectures multiply availability (0.999 * 0.999 = 0.998), degrading overall uptime. Parallel architectures multiply unavailabilities (1 - (0.001)^2 = 0.999999), dramatically increasing fault tolerance.

nodes.label: Single Web Server (99.9%)
nodes.detail: Single point of failure; failure causes immediate complete service outage.

nodes.label: Single Database (99.9%)
nodes.detail: Compound availability drops to 99.8% (8.7 hours downtime per year).

nodes.label: Redundant Ingress LB
nodes.detail: Distributes requests across independent availability zones.

nodes.label: Active Replica (Zone A)
nodes.detail: Serving active production load in zone us-central1-a.

nodes.label: Standby Replica (Zone B)
nodes.detail: Independent failure domain; combined availability jumps to 99.9999% (31s downtime/yr).

steps.title: Serial Risk Demonstration
steps.action: A single crash on either server takes down entire application.

steps.title: Parallel Fault Isolation
steps.action: Load balancer distributes across Zone A and Zone B simultaneously.
steps.why_traversal: Unavailability of Zone A does not impact Zone B serving capability.

scenarios.label: Complete Datacenter Zone Loss
scenarios.root_cause: Major power substation explosion takes entire us-central1-a zone offline.
scenarios.diverted_path: Load balancer directs 100% traffic to Zone B; users experience zero downtime.
scenarios.blast_radius: Confined to Zone A; service availability SLA preserved.
scenarios.recovery: Regional MIG automatically scales up additional instances in Zone C.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
